g.text: The full spatial source, overlapping patches and optimal residual
Every original raw coefficient and cross-face entry retained [SCR7–SCR13]
T is the full signed five-moment matrix. Zero eigenvalues of G are retained.
The formula does not assume that the actual residual is small.
κ* = 4/5; a = 1/(100j); q = 100j, with all 3q²(q+1) face samples equal to 1.
These are bounds for an original fitting cube, not sampled vacuum norms.
The term 24ℓ² comes from every original crossing face. Full finite counts and caps remain.
Actual conditional covariance and all cross-patch source terms determine G, H and T.
Complete proofs and original limits: SCR7–SCR13.
